slot_scores.name: missing_profit_maximization_objective
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Is the objective to maximize total weekly profit, or is it to minimize total weekly cost while satisfying the requirement that profit be at least 3000 yuan?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly asked about the objective and whether it is to maximize total weekly profit.

slot_scores.name: missing_idle_time_minimization_objective
slot_scores.rationale: The agent never asked about minimizing idle time, unused process capacity, or any secondary multi-objective weighting by process cost.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: The only objective is to maximize total weekly profit; idle-time minimization with cost-proportional weights is not part of the model.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The user never confirmed whether idle time should be minimized or weighted by process cost, yet the agent's READY_TO_MODEL summary confirms only the profit-maximization objective.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The P0 objective slot was resolved, but the P1 idle-time/secondary-objective slot remained unresolved when the agent entered READY_TO_MODEL.

summary: The agent correctly recovered the main profit-maximization objective and key constraints, but it stopped before addressing the secondary idle-time minimization objective, leaving a P1 hidden slot unresolved.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
